fixes.what: Keyframe french-africa_1900 is 'ok' for 1900-1904 although the ledger gains the whole Algerian Sahara in 1903 (/ledger/35, confidence 3) and the AOF Sahara-Sahel interior in 1904 (/ledger/36): about 5.6 million km2 enter the ledger one to two years before any keyframe draws them.
fixes.why: shapes.csv: french-africa_1900 4,488,516 km2 (1900-1904), french-africa_1905 10,130,495 km2; the keyframe_review/18 note itself counts Algeria +5,263, Niger +4,204, Mauritania +3,990, Mali +3,681 cells in 1905. Brief rule 4: an event with no trace in the keyframes is fine only if small or the keyframe is marked adjust.
fixes.fix: Add a new keyframe french-africa_1903 (from 1903, to 1904, verdict adjust, correction = union of Cliopatria French Africa 1900 and intersect(minus(French Africa 1905, French Africa 1900), Algeria)), and mark french-africa_1900 adjust 'valid for 1900-1902'. For /ledger/36 either draw the AOF interior in the same new keyframe or re-date it to 1905 at confidence 1: the French West Africa page's 1904 sentences ('formally named French West Africa (AOF)', 'both Mauritania and Niger were classed Military Territories') date an administrative act, not an acquisition, so lower /ledger/36 to confidence 1 in either case.

fixes.what: New keyframe french-africa_1881 (1881-1884) omits Guinea while /ledger/14 gains all of Guinea (about 245,000 km2) in 1884 at confidence 3.
fixes.why: Scramble for Africa page: 'In 1884, Germany declared Togoland, the Cameroons and South West Africa to be under its protection;' ... 'France occupied Guinea.' Cliopatria draws Guinea from 1885.
fixes.fix: Either split the keyframe (french-africa_1881 to 1883, new french-africa_1884 = 1880 shape plus Tunisia plus Guinea) or say in the note that the 1884 Guinea gain is drawn from 1885.

fixes.what: No gains from republic-of-liberia, although the Liberia dossier records two losses to french-africa.
fixes.why: republic-of-liberia ledger: 1892-12 loss to french-africa (Franco-Liberian treaty of 8 December 1892, source https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ivory_Coast%E2%80%93Liberia_border) and 1907-09 loss to french-africa (18 September 1907, source https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guinea%E2%80%93Liberia_border).
fixes.fix: Add gain events 1892-12 and 1907-09, counterpart republic-of-liberia, with the same regions as the Liberia dossier's losses, citing those two pages (add them to sources).

fixes.what: Wadai is a single 1911 gain at confidence 1, while the wadai-empire dossier records a war and an occupation by french-africa with no mirror here.
fixes.why: wadai-empire ledger (source https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wadai_War, confidence 3): contest_start 1908-05, occupation_start 1909-06, contest_end 1911-10, occupation_end and dissolve to french-africa 1912.
fixes.fix: Open the Wadai War page; add contest_start 1908-05, occupation_start 1909-06 (Abeche), contest_end 1911-10 and occupation_end 1912, move the gain to 1912 (or explain the year), and add the Wadai War to wars[] with its zone.

fixes.what: Dahomey's 1890 loss to french-africa and the two Franco-Dahomean wars have no mirror; the 1894 gain has no month.
fixes.why: dahomey ledger: contest_start 1890-03, loss 1890-10 and contest_end 1890-10 (First_Franco-Dahomean_War, confidence 3); contest_start 1892-07, contest_end 1894-01, loss and dissolve 1894-01 (Second_Franco-Dahomean_War / Dahomey). The Scramble for Africa page gives only 'in 1894'.
fixes.fix: Add the 1890-10 gain from dahomey and the contest pairs (or say why the wars hold no ground), give /ledger/20 month 1 from the Dahomey page, and add the First Franco-Dahomean War to wars[].

fixes.what: Porto-Novo is gained only in 1882; the French Africa page and the kingdom-of-porto-novo dossier also give the 1863 protectorate.
fixes.why: French Africa page list: 'Porto-Novo(protectorate) (1863–1865, 1882)'. kingdom-of-porto-novo ledger: 1863 loss and dissolve to french-africa (Porto-Novo page, confidence 3). Counterpart string 'Porto-Novo kingdom' replaced by the slug kingdom-of-porto-novo (applied, see next finding).
fixes.fix: Add the 1863 protectorate (vassal_start or gain, counterpart kingdom-of-porto-novo) and its 1865 end, keep 1882; note the disagreement with the Porto-Novo dossier, which ends the kingdom in 1863.

fixes.what: Counterparts written as names ('Porto-Novo kingdom', 'Dar al Kuti' twice, 'Emirate of Trarza') although those dossiers now exist.
fixes.why: history/polities/ holds kingdom-of-porto-novo.json, dar-al-kuti.json and emirate-of-trarza.json; emirate-of-trarza records loss 1902-12 to french-africa, dar-al-kuti loss 1912-12.

fixes.what: Dar al Kuti ends as a vassal in 1912 but is never gained: the page says it was annexed.
fixes.why: French Equatorial Africa page: 'declaring the slaves in Dar al Kuti free and annexing the territory in 1912'. dar-al-kuti ledger: loss 1912-12 and dissolve to french-africa. Madagascar is handled correctly with vassal_end plus gain in 1897.
fixes.fix: Add a 1912 gain, counterpart dar-al-kuti, same region (admin1 Bamingui-Bangoran), source French_Equatorial_Africa, confidence 3; the Dar al Kuti dossier should add the 1897 vassal_start (it has none).

fixes.what: Tunisia is gained from nazi-germany on 13 May 1943 although the ledger never lost or occupied it in 1942.
fixes.why: French protectorate of Tunisia page: 'The occupation of the country in 1942 by Germany'; 'when the Axis were forced out of Tunisia in 1943'; Bey deposed 'on 13 May 1943'. No 1942 event in the ledger.
fixes.fix: Add an occupation_start 1942 (counterpart nazi-germany, the eastern Tunisian bridgehead, month from the Tunisian campaign page if opened) and change /ledger/63 to occupation_end 1943-05 with the same counterpart.

fixes.what: Djibouti is lost to british-africa in December 1942 but regained in 1943 from free-french (/ledger/61); british-africa has no mirror.
fixes.why: French Somaliland infobox (opened): 'British occupation: December 28, 1942' and no sentence on the return. british-africa ledger has no Djibouti event 1940-1943.
fixes.fix: Make the 1942 event an occupation by british-africa (occupation_start 1942-12, occupation_end 1943 at confidence 1) or name free-french on both sides with a page that says so; either way the 1942 and 1943 counterparts must agree, and british-africa (af-08) needs the mirror.

fixes.what: The mandate years end the occupation of Neukamerun, Cameroon (1919) and Togo (1922-07) without any gain, so the ledger never makes them French land though every later keyframe draws them.
fixes.why: Schema: occupation_end ends a hatched occupation; annexation is a gain (the dossier itself pairs vassal_end with a gain for Madagascar in 1897). /ledger/51 text also says Neukamerun became 'part of French Cameroon', but its region (French Africa 1905 minus 1911) is the slice of Gabon, Middle Congo and Ubangi-Shari that went back to the AEF.
fixes.fix: Add gain events from german-africa beside /ledger/51, /ledger/52 and /ledger/54 (same regions, same sources); correct the /ledger/51 text to the AEF colonies.
